subject: Private deployment: billing schedule, escrow and milestone-based amortization
messages:
From: Elena Varga <elena.varga@medibase.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@medibase.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Questions on VPC billing cadence and escrow for license fee

Hi Monica,

Thanks for the draft SOW — we reviewed it with finance and legal. A couple of high-level asks before we route to procurement: 

1) Can Redwood split the platform fee over milestones tied to our go-live phases (pilot, phased roll, GA) rather than billing up-front? Our auditors prefer amortization tied to delivery.
2) Legal asked whether Redwood will accept a third-party escrow for the license artifacts and whether there is a standard escrow instruction we can review.
3) We also need clarity on support tier start date vs. billing (should support begin after first node goes live or after GA?).

Can you confirm what flexibility you can offer and share a simple payment schedule? Attaching our internal budget window — procurement will need a clear PO path.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Varga
Head of Infrastructure Programs
Medibase Health
[attachment: Medibase_BudgetWindow_Q4.pdf (pdf)]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Varga <elena.varga@medibase.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 10:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Questions on VPC billing cadence and escrow for license fee

Elena — thanks for the clear summary. High level response and a proposed path below.

Proposed commercial options (we can pick one to put in the SOW):
- Option A (Milestone amortization): Platform fee split 40/30/30 tied to Pilot (ingest + validation), Phased roll (50% of clusters live), GA. Invoice on milestone acceptance sign-off.
- Option B (Hybrid): 50% platform fee up front (to cover reserved capacity), 50% amortized over 12 months.

Escrow: Redwood is open to third-party escrow for runtime artifacts. We typically use IronBank/CertEscrow contracts; attaching a short escrow instruction draft for your counsel to review. Note: escrow acceptance will be conditional on a small one-time admin fee and that the escrow release triggers align to a failure-to-support or acquisition event.

Support start: our default is support activates on first node-in-service with production metrics enabled. If you need support billed only from GA we can create a delayed invoice milestone (often used for customers who want amortization to start later).

I've attached a one-page commercial term summary and a redlineable SOW with milestone definitions. If that looks OK I can loop in Contracts (Irene) and Sales Ops (Marissa) to lock the PO language and payment terms.

Proposed next step: quick call Friday to pick Option A vs B and agree escrow handoff.

Regards,
Monica
Monica Patel
Enterprise Sales — Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
[attachment: SOW_Medibase_VPC_v1.2.pdf (pdf)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Varga <elena.varga@medibase.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Questions on VPC billing cadence and escrow for license fee

Elena — quick commercial note from Sales Ops:

- If you commit to a 24-month minimum on the Dedicated/Reserved nodes we can extend a 12% one-time launch discount applied to the platform fee (applied against Option A or B).
- For milestone amortization we include acceptance criteria per milestone (test SLOs & runbook sign-off) to avoid disputes on invoicing.
- Escrow admin fee: $7,500 one-time (covers escrow account setup and yearly verification).

Irene — can you confirm if Redwood legal can accept the escrow instruction draft in the attachments or if you need changes?

Elena — if procurement needs a single consolidated invoice, we can provide consolidated monthly billing after milestones are triggered (combine platform + support into one invoice).

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
[attachment: Commercial_Term_Summary.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Elena Varga <elena.varga@medibase.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@medibase.com>, Contracts <contracts@medibase.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Questions on VPC billing cadence and escrow for license fee

Thanks — that framing helps. Procurement would like the following clarified before we issue a PO: 

1) Exact milestone acceptance checklist (we need artifact + test list for Pilot and Phased roll).
2) Confirmation that the escrow will be executed with a neutral third party and that the admin fee is a one-time redwood charge.
3) Start date for support — we prefer billing to align with GA (so support invoices begin on GA invoice). Will Redwood accept that?

On discounts: the 12% launch discount is in line with our budget if we can get the milestone definitions and acceptance checklist by Wednesday.

I can move this to procurement once we have the SOW updated and a single-sheet payment schedule.

Elena

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Varga <elena.varga@medibase.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 16:43:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Questions on VPC billing cadence and escrow for license fee

Elena — quick note from Solutions/Eng on milestone acceptance and SLO credits to make commercial acceptance less risky for Medibase: 

- Pilot acceptance: ingest of a representative dataset, KV cache warm-up, and 72-hour low-latency window (p95 token latency under agreed threshold) with runbook verification.
- Phased roll: 50% of target throughput for 7 days with no more than 2 SEV incidents; runbook handover and runbook smoke test complete.
- GA: full production throughput for 14 days and SRE knowledge transfer workshop delivered.

SLO credit model: for missed SLOs tied to platform (latency/availability) we propose service credits capped at 10% of the monthly support fee for the affected invoice period; production-impacting failures that match the escrow release conditions can be escalated to the escrow agent as per the instruction draft.

On support start: engineering is fine with support activation at GA if that is a contractual requirement — we recommend Redwood maintain a very light monitoring window during Pilot (advisory) but will not start billed support until GA per your ask.

I'll attach a short milestone checklist and suggested acceptance sign-off template to the Drive link and we can incorporate into the SOW.

— Jordan
Principal Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
[attachment: Milestone_Acceptance_Checklist.docx (docx)]
